rulesTestNames: lets current managers read WhatsApp thread views and one thread's messages
owner: Host read model projector: hostReadModels WhatsApp thread view triggers
read: current organizer managers get and list (organizerId equality) while their account is not deleted; a view not written yet reads as missing
write: server only; written from the thread and its contact, deleted with the thread
migrationNotes: The view equals the summary the retired listOrganizerWhatsappThreads callable returned, without the clock-dependent serviceWindowOpen flag. The host-whatsapp-thread-views copy-forward migration creates views for threads retained before the triggers.
Account deletion unlinks linkedUid on the views as it does on contacts.
